title: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down
cue: What to say after shaking out the bed
arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbee wabika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa'in arsaltahaa fahfaz'haa bimaa tahfazu bihis-saaliheen
translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, guard it with what You guard the righteous with.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6320: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9477

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela ends تحفظ به الصالحين; hadith-api has عبادك الصالحين. We follow the printed edition.

usage.evidence: When one of you goes to bed, let him shake out his bed with the inside of his wrapper, for he does not know what has come onto it after him, then say this (al-Bukhari 6320).
